subject.title: Feature request: Local plugin scanner CLI for pre-publish validation

question: Should the public scan service accept ephemeral local plugin artifacts, and if it does, should results be documented as best-effort preflight guidance or guaranteed to match hosted publish-time ClawScan decisions?
rationale: Current main intentionally separates public deterministic Plugin Inspector validation from hosted security scanning, and choosing artifact handling plus parity semantics changes a durable security and CLI contract.

options.title: Best-effort authenticated preflight
options.body: Accept bounded ephemeral plugin uploads, expose structured findings, and document hosted publish-time enforcement as authoritative.

options.title: Exact hosted parity
options.body: Expose the complete hosted scanner locally and accept compatibility obligations for equivalent local and publish-time decisions.

options.title: Keep validation-only boundary
options.body: Continue offering offline Plugin Inspector checks while limiting security scans to published artifacts and trusted repository tooling.

recommendation.title: Best-effort authenticated preflight
recommendation.body: Accept bounded ephemeral plugin uploads, expose structured findings, and document hosted publish-time enforcement as authoritative.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has the strongest recent history across all three relevant surfaces: public scan UX, local dry-run scanning, and plugin validation.
